title: Why unconcerned Steph Curry is not rushing Warriors contract extension
summary: If there are any thoughts or concerns that Steph Curry isn’t going to be a Warrior for life, that thinking certainly isn’t coming from him.  Curry on Saturday became eligible to sign a new maximum contract extension as he prepares for his 18th season in a Warriors jersey.  “There’s no question I want to be here the rest of my career, and I’m pretty sure that’s going to happen,” Curry said to NBC Sports Bay Area in an exclusive interview.
